content: The adaptation layer must expose a POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint fully compatible with standard OpenAI clients, implement bidirectional format conversion (upstream: OpenAI standard chat completion parameters to Grok frontend private request structure; downstream: Grok private SSE stream to standard OpenAI streaming chunk output), and include built-in session management supporting conversation creation/reuse, health check endpoints, and主动 throwing exceptions when authentication fails.
